composites.MA: equal-weight average of valid bounded bullish-absorption components
composites.MC: equal-weight average of valid bounded bullish-continuation components

depth.book_slope: mean bid/ask touch-to-outer-row price distance divided by displayed side size
depth.distance_weighting: row size / (1 + non-negative distance from touch in basis points)
depth.replenishment: cumulative displayed additions / cumulative displayed removals since the book became complete

price_impact: signed midpoint movement divided by supported probable side volume; stored raw, per-share, notional and basis-point forms
trade_side_method: compare Last price with most recent valid prevailing quote subject to frozen maximum quote age
archetype_relationships: descriptive same-direction, opposite-direction, neutral, or insufficient-data comparison; frozen archetypes are never modified
